_readme: The price book. Every number here must come from the vendor's own pricing page —
nothing in this file is guessed, and a null price is left null on purpose.
A null entry is NOT an error. The ledger still records the usage at $0 and logs a
warning naming the sku, so volume is never lost while a price is missing. Fill the
number in, re-run `pnpm --filter @acme/api cost:seed`, and the rate applies from its
effectiveFrom onward. Past events keep the price that was frozen onto them.
microUsdPerUnit is USD * 1,000,000 for `unitSize` base units.
(storage is metered in micro-GB-months, hence the 1000000 unitSize)
To change a price, edit the value and set a NEW effectiveFrom. Never rewrite history:
corrections are inserts, so a vendor price rise cannot silently restate last quarter.

rates.source: https://openai.com/api/pricing/ — quoted per minute, so unitSize is 60
SSLCommerz merchant agreement — commission on SellPilot's own subscription charges
NVIDIA NIM free tier — priced at zero deliberately, so the volume is still tracked and the day it stops being free is visible
Coolify VPS invoice — fixed monthly, allocated across stores at read time
Redis host invoice — 0 if self-hosted on the same VPS as `hosting`, to avoid double-counting

fx.source: Bank settlement rate — set this to the rate you actually convert at, not the mid-market rate
